279633051.description:
Lot of 3 Vintage Smoking Pipes Dr. Grabow Briar Bent Wood Corn Cob
This listing includes a lot of three vintage smoking pipes with distinct designs. The first pipe has a dark, rusticated briar bowl and shank with an amber acrylic stem, marked 'Dr. Grabow' and 'SERIES 100'. The second pipe features a smooth, bent wooden bowl and shank with an amber stem and metal accent, showing wear and patina on the mouthpiece. The third pipe is a classic corn cob style with a textured natural bowl, wooden shank, and amber stem. All pipes show signs of use and age, suitable for collectors or display.
